verses.pali: “So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kañci saṅkhāraṁ sukhato samanupassanto …pe…
verses.english: “Mendicants, it is quite impossible for a mendicant who regards any condition as pleasurable to accept views that agree with the teaching. …
It’s quite possible for a mendicant who regards all conditions as suffering to accept views that agree with the teaching. …”
